about: Synthetic AskGogo memory fixtures for the hybrid-recall evaluation (Same Brain 3.0). Fictional people (Divya, Nithin); no live customer data. Each tenant is a separate scope. 'exact' rows stand in for semantic-graph assertions (verified provider reads or owner statements); 'memories' stand in for memory_embeddings rows. 'stale' marks memories whose graph assertions were superseded by a later correction.
